thread:
maria g.: Quick design FYI — mobile console: metrics table overflows and the left sidebar swipe gesture is stealing horizontal scroll. Screenshot/recording attached (Figma link). Repro on iPhone SE and 12?
jamal: Yep repro'd on SE. When table uses `overflow-x: auto`, swiping from the left edge opens the sidebar instead of scrolling the table. :grimacing:
elaine (design): Oof. I think we should adjust the collapse breakpoint — currently it becomes swipeable at 720px. Maybe keep it docked until 600px and only enable edge-swipe under that. Also increase touch targets for row actions.
ryan (frontend): A few approaches: a) expose a small edge-handle (24px) to open the sidebar, b) require a two-finger/long-press to open, c) detect horizontal scroll intent on the table and block the swipe. I'm leaning to a) or c). Technically we can combine `touch-action: pan-y` on table container + a JS deltaX/deltaY heuristic.
elaine (design): Agree on a handle. Accessibility notes: when the sidebar overlays, set `aria-hidden` on underlying content, trap focus inside the sidebar, and announce "Sidebar opened" for screen readers.
jamal: Quick prototype idea: only register the swipe listener inside `--sidebar-swipe-zone: 20px` and let tables use native scrolling elsewhere. Also add `-webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch` and `touch-action: pan-y pinch-zoom` on the table container to preserve smooth scroll.
maria g.: Also — current truncation of metric names when action buttons are visible makes items ambiguous. Can we allow a two-line wrap for names on very narrow screens and stack/condense actions into an overflow menu?
ryan (frontend): I can try two-line wrap + move actions into an overflow kebab on <360px. Will add `aria-label` to the overflow menu for accessibility. Planning to open a small PR with screenshots and recordings.
design-bot: Reminder: mobile UX crit on Friday 10:30am — please bring updated Figma frames and interaction gifs.
elaine (design): :thumbsup: Jamal — can you include short gifs showing swipe vs table scroll in the PR so we can validate the interaction?
jamal: Will do, ETA EOD today.
maria g.: Thanks team — holding off on canary until we verify behavior on a couple of physical devices. "
